scope: record_quiz_event (public.quiz_events anonymous funnel); see docs/operations/quiz-funnel-events.md and docs/operations/quiz-funnel-alerts.md
threshold_note: Starting values chosen from the documented cap (120 events/min) and per-visit volume (at most 7 events), NOT from measured production baselines. The web client stops sending for the rest of the session after the first failure, so one real visitor produces at most one 429/4xx. Re-tune after the first week of real traffic.

stats_inputs.edge_429_gateway: edge-status-mix.sql (informational, not alerting; sb_error_code split UNVERIFIED on real logs)
stats_inputs.pt429_log_count: postgres-log-sqlstate.sql (severity ERROR only, one row per error)
stats_inputs.probe_sent: provided by the scheduler that sends the synthetic probe: probes sent in the window, excluding the newest 3 minutes (log ingestion lag); 0 when no probe runs

alerts.title: Quiz event cap hit: PT429 errors in the Postgres log
alerts.meaning: The global 120/min cap is being hit and real visitors' events are being dropped (flood, ad burst above the cap, or an attack). Not a 5xx: the 5xx alert cannot see this. Counts severity ERROR rows only (one per raised error).

alerts.title: Quiz event cap hit: HTTP 429 from PostgREST at the API gateway
alerts.meaning: Same event as QZ-429-PT429-LOG seen from the gateway; kept because the log-pipeline fields are not verified on hosted. Gateway-originated 429s (edge_429_gateway) are excluded, but that split rests on response.headers.sb_error_code, which is UNVERIFIED on real logs: if the header is not captured every 429 counts here (a platform 429 would then fire this alert, the safe direction).

alerts.title: Quiz event cap hit: saturated one-minute counters in the database
alerts.meaning: private.quiz_event_rate has minutes where n >= cap. Does not depend on the log pipeline. Needs a manual run as postgres, or a dedicated read-only role added by a separately reviewed migration (never the postgres or service_role credential in a scheduler); see the runbook.

alerts.title: Quiz event 4xx share (excluding 429)
alerts.meaning: Oversize or malformed payloads (400), a rotated or wrong public key (401/403), or a client regression. Oversize requests are never counted by the cap, so this is the only alert that sees an oversize flood.

probe.status: DEFINED, NOT ACTIVE. Nothing in this repository sends it or schedules it.
probe.purpose: Proves end to end that the PT400 log row, the gateway 4xx row and the RPC path regex are all visible, so a wrong field key, a path format change or an ingestion gap cannot read as a quiet system (Themis N44-01).
probe.request: POST /rest/v1/rpc/record_quiz_event with the project's PUBLIC anon key and one oversize argument (for example a 65-character p_network). The function raises PT400 before any table access (pgTAP 0024), so nothing is written and the cap counter is not touched.
probe.expected: HTTP 400, one postgres_logs row with SQLSTATE PT400 and severity ERROR per probe, one edge_logs 4xx row per probe
probe.evaluation: edge_4xx_other >= probe_sent and pt400_log_count >= probe_sent (liveness QZ-LIVE-PROBE-*); probes are subtracted from the 4xx share; recurring checks use >=, the one-time dev calibration in the runbook requires exactly 1 row per probe on an otherwise quiet project

liveness.title: edge_logs has rows in the window
liveness.failure: no edge_logs rows in the window: ingestion gap, retention or an idle project without probe; the gateway readings are not evidence of a quiet system

liveness.title: edge_logs rows carry request.method, request.path and response.status_code
liveness.failure: edge_logs has rows but none carries the field keys the queries use: the keys are wrong on this project

liveness.title: postgres_logs has rows in the window
liveness.failure: no postgres_logs rows in the window: ingestion gap or retention; the PT429 reading is not evidence of a quiet system

liveness.title: postgres_logs rows carry parsed.sql_state_code
liveness.failure: postgres_logs has rows but none carries parsed.sql_state_code: the key is wrong on this project

liveness.title: postgres_logs rows carry parsed.error_severity
liveness.failure: postgres_logs has rows but none carries parsed.error_severity: the key is wrong on this project

liveness.title: PT429 rows of any severity imply PT429 rows with severity ERROR
liveness.failure: PT429 rows exist but none has severity ERROR: the severity value differs on this project, so pt429_log_count is blind

liveness.title: PT400 rows of any severity imply PT400 rows with severity ERROR
liveness.failure: PT400 rows exist but none has severity ERROR: the severity value differs on this project, so the severity filter is blind

liveness.title: every synthetic probe produced a PT400 log row
liveness.failure: fewer PT400 log rows than probes sent: the Postgres log path (or its SQLSTATE or severity key) is blind

liveness.title: every synthetic probe produced a gateway 4xx row on the RPC path
liveness.failure: fewer gateway 4xx rows on the RPC path than probes sent: the gateway log path (or its method, path or status key) is blind
